_comment: SMOKE ABLATED RUN: 170M, 'Harry Potter' held out of the loss.
Identical to train_170m_control.json in every field except 'save_folder'
and the 'untaught' block. Same init_seed and same data_loader seed, so both
runs see the same chunks in the same order in the same batches -- the only
difference is that blacklisted chunks contribute no gradient.
'blacklist' names a file of Wikidata QIDs, relative to Untaught/. The
chunk ids are resolved from Elasticsearch when training starts -- nothing
is precomputed and nothing is written to disk.

_thresholds_comment: Per-source mention-confidence cutoffs for the retrieval. A mention
counts if it clears AT LEAST ONE of them, so this is how aggressively
this run excludes -- a property of the run, not of the entity list.
These are the values the paper validated on a 60-entity dev set
(section 5.2, Table 4). Lower them for higher recall and more collateral
chunks; raise them to exclude only high-confidence mentions. Any source
you omit keeps its default; an unknown name is a hard error.
_case_sensitive_comment: Which index the retrieval runs against: true -> lment_cs (restored from
enwiki_case_sensitive), false -> lment_ci (from enwiki). QID retrieval is
case-agnostic, so true is the right default; flip it only if you know the
case-folded index is the one you want.
